# Turn a Shopify payout report into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free Shopify payout to journal converter: proves the transactions add up to the payout, splits gross sales, Shopify Payments fees, refunds, chargebacks and shipping labels by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
